name: Fanart.tv
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: Fetches high-quality artwork from Fanart.tv — posters, backgrounds, logos, disc art, clearart, and banners for movies, TV, and music. Requires a free Fanart.tv API key.
fixMatchHint: Movies: enter a TMDB ID or URL — movie:550 or https://fanart.tv/movie/550/. TV: enter a TVDB ID — tv:76290 (TVDB, not TMDB). Music: enter a MusicBrainz artist MBID — artist:b10bbbfc-cf9e-42e0-be17-e2c3e1d2600d.

background_tasks.description: Downloads artwork from Fanart.tv for items that have a matched TMDB or MusicBrainz ID but no Fanart.tv artwork yet.
Re-downloads all Fanart.tv artwork to pick up newly added community images.
